headline: Does Cognizant (CTSH) Turning AI Deals And Dividends Into A Durable Competitive Edge?
summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions recently reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$5,481 million and net income of US$636 million, while also affirming a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.33 per share payable on August 25, 2026. Alongside these financials, Cognizant expanded its AI footprint through the launch of an EMEA AI Unit, a Thailand-focused Gulf Edge partnership, and a five-year modernization and responsible-AI agreement with The Andover Companies, underscoring its...
